title: How to Speed Up WordPress
description: A planned practical guide to finding meaningful WordPress performance issues before adding another optimization plugin.
metaDescription: Editorial preview: a future KreativWP guide to speeding up a WordPress site.
intro: This article is a working editorial outline, not a completed performance prescription. The published version will document test conditions and practical trade-offs.

sections.title: Measure before changing anything
sections.body: A useful optimization begins with a repeatable baseline and a clear idea of what users experience.

sections.title: Find the limiting layer
sections.body: Themes, plugins, images, third-party scripts, caching, and hosting have different failure modes and should not be treated as one problem.

sections.title: Keep the solution maintainable
sections.body: Prefer a smaller set of understood changes over an opaque stack of overlapping optimization tools.
